decision.question: Are the scene's surfaces and tonal values represented in a pencil-drawn shading style?
decision.criteria: Pass if pencil-like shading broadly conveys the scene's tonal modeling through directional strokes, hatching, form-following graphite marks or convincing rubbed graphite tones. Smoothness alone does not disqualify graphite shading, and isolated imperfect surfaces do not require failure. Fail if substantial surfaces retain photographic tonal modeling, realistic specular reflections or photographic material textures merely covered by grain. Desaturation, softened contrast, stronger outlines and uniform texture alone do not satisfy this shading condition. Assess interior tonal rendering independently of contours. Use unknown only when the visual evidence is insufficient to establish the shading style.
